claims.head: The Hurricanes should pile up the shots
claims.call: The Hurricanes’ shot volume score is at least their usual 118.

claims.body: The Hurricanes shoot from anywhere, and the Canucks are one of the league’s worst at stopping it. Kevin Lankinen had better be ready from the opening faceoff.

CAR.head: The Hurricanes should be in control
CAR.body: Carolina has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. If the Canucks want to spoil it, start with getting good looks.

VAN.head: A steep climb for the Canucks
VAN.body: Carolina has been out-chancing opponents by a wide margin lately and has home-ice advantage. To pull this off, the Canucks can start with getting good looks, plus Kevin Lankinen stealing the show.
